thread:
alex: Heads up — DeployBot flagged a 503 spike for embeddings-eu. I'm proposing an emergency pin + partial drain while we validate the hotfix. Need fast approvals (2/3) to use the expedited window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Incident #4721 — 503 spike on /v1/embeddings (eu). Current error rate: 4.3%. Suggested action: canary drain + pin to v2.3.7-hotfix.

maria: what's the rollback threshold? don't want a bad pin to make it worse.

sam: rollback plan: pin -> monitor 1m canary at 20% traffic. If error rate > 3% or latency +50ms, rollback to v2.3.6. Ops will hold rollback cmd ready.

dena: +1 from ops if rollbacks are automated. also confirm KV cache warm-up for v2.3.7-hotfix?

priya: perf check: model memory and batch paths look fine in staging replay. +1 from perf. recommend 20% initial shift for 5m.

alex: ok applying pin command now once we have 2 approvals. @maria @priya please react if you approve.

maria: approving. :white_check_mark:

priya: approving. :thumbsup:

alex: running pin: ```
deployctl pin --svc embeddings-eu --ver v2.3.7-hotfix --reason "503 spike" --window 30m
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Starting pin and drain sequence. Initial traffic shift: 20% to pinned hosts.

maria: keeping drain at 20% for first 5m, then evaluate. alerting thresholds set to: error_rate > 3%, p95 latency +100ms.

sam: release note draft (short): "v2.3.7-hotfix — batching NPE fix for short sequences. Emergency pin to mitigate 503s in EU embeddings." I'll add to changelog.

dena: rollback command ready: `deployctl rollback --svc embeddings-eu --ver v2.3.6` — ops on standby.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +2m: error rate 0.8% (down from 4.3%), p95 latency +4ms. No new 5xx alerts.

alex: great, rolling forward. tagging changelog and notifying infra-privacy for customer notification check.

priya: monitor KV cache hit-rate for 10m — if it drops we may need a staggered warmup.

maria: agreed. scheduling a quick follow-up in 25m to confirm lift of expedited flag.

sam: note for billing: extra burst GPU capacity used during hotfix window — capture for chargeback.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll post a short postmortem template in #eng-releases after stabilizing. If anything spikes, call it out here and we'll rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Pin completed. Expedited window active for 30 minutes. Will post final metrics at completion.
